resources.string: This app trains your ear to recognize a note\'s place in a key — not its name, not perfect pitch. Nothing to read, nothing to play.

Almost everything you do here follows the same pattern: first, some notes play to establish \"home.\" That opening always uses more notes than you have answer buttons for — that\'s normal, not a hint to track.

Then, after a short pause, one note plays by itself. That single note is the only thing you\'re answering about, and it always matches one of your buttons. Tap where it sits, relative to home. If you\'re not sure — guess. That\'s how this gets easier.
You can replay any sound as many times as you want, any time. It\'s never held against you.
First up: a few short listening questions to find your starting point. No score, no timer, nothing to get \"wrong.\"
You\'ve mastered every set — reviews will come up as they\'re due.
